lead: The options are one adjective or adverb in several degrees (fast, faster, fastest), or small words such as than, as, to. A signal word elsewhere in the sentence tells you which.
選項是同一個形容詞或副詞的不同級別（fast、faster、fastest），或 than、as、to 這類小字。句子裡的線索字會告訴你該選哪一個。
steps: Search the sentence for than, as, the, of all, or in + a group.
在句子裡找 than、as、the、of all，或 in 加一個範圍。
than needs a comparative. as … as needs the plain form. the + a group needs a superlative.
than 配比較級。as … as 中間用原級。the 加範圍配最高級。
If the options are small words, ask which word goes with the adjective: superior to, prefer … to.
選項若是小字，就看哪個字跟前面的形容詞搭配：superior to、prefer … to。

head: as … as with the plain form
as … as 中間用原級
body: Put the plain adjective between the two as, never a comparative. The negative is not as … as.
兩個 as 中間放原級形容詞，不放比較級。否定用 not as … as。
ex: This model is as efficient as the previous one.
這個型號和上一代一樣有效率。
The new office is not as large as the old one.
新辦公室沒有舊的那麼大。

head: Comparative + than
比較級加 than
body: Short adjectives take -er; long ones take more. Strengthen a comparative with much, far, even, still, significantly, never with very.
短的形容詞加 -er，長的用 more。要加強比較級，用 much、far、even、still、significantly，不能用 very。
ex: The new printer is much faster than the old one.
新印表機比舊的快很多。
Shipping by air is significantly more expensive than shipping by sea.
空運比海運貴得多。

head: The + superlative
the 加最高級
body: A superlative usually takes the, and often a phrase that sets the group: of all, in the region, among. One of the + superlative is followed by a plural noun.
最高級前面通常有 the，後面常有指出範圍的片語：of all、in the region、among。one of the 加最高級，後面接複數名詞。
ex: This is the most popular product in our catalog.
這是我們型錄上最受歡迎的產品。
Taipei is one of the largest markets in the region.
台北是這個地區最大的市場之一。

head: The more …, the more …
越……越……
body: the + comparative, the + comparative. The first part is the condition, the second part is the result. Both parts need the.
the + 比較級，the + 比較級。前半是條件，後半是結果。兩邊都要有 the。
ex: The sooner you register, the more you save.
越早報名，省得越多。
The earlier the team starts, the sooner it finishes.
團隊越早開始，就越早完成。

head: Multiples
倍數表達
body: Use twice as + plain adjective + as, or three times as + plain adjective + as. The adjective stays in the plain form.
用 twice as + 原級 + as，或 three times as + 原級 + as。形容詞維持原級。
ex: Our revenue this year was twice as high as last year's.
我們今年的營收是去年的兩倍。
The new warehouse is three times as large as the old one.
新倉庫的大小是舊倉庫的三倍。

head: Fixed comparison patterns
固定的比較搭配
body: any other takes a singular noun. superior, inferior, senior, junior, prior take to, not than. prefer A to B. Choosing one of two, formal English uses the + comparative.
any other 後面接單數名詞。superior、inferior、senior、junior、prior 後面接 to，不接 than。prefer A to B。從兩者中選一個時，正式英文用 the + 比較級。
ex: This laptop is lighter than any other model on the market.
這台筆電比市面上任何其他型號都輕。
Their customer service is superior to ours.
他們的客服比我們的好。
Of the two proposals, Ms. Hall's is the more practical.
兩份提案之中，Hall 女士的比較實際。

pairs.right: The new model is much lighter.
pairs.wrong: The new model is very lighter.
why: very cannot strengthen a comparative. Use much, far or even.
very 不能修飾比較級，要用 much、far 或 even。

pairs.right: This plan is superior to the old one.
pairs.wrong: This plan is superior than the old one.

pairs.right: It is cheaper than any other model.
pairs.wrong: It is cheaper than any other models.
why: any other is followed by a singular noun.

pairs.right: Our prices are lower than those of our competitors.
pairs.wrong: Our prices are lower than our competitors.
why: Compare prices with prices: those of stands for the prices of.
要拿價格比價格：those of 代表 the prices of。

head: Words followed by to
後面接 to 的字
items: 喜歡 A 勝過 B

head: Words that go before a comparative
放在比較級前面的字

traps: Do not double the degree: more cheaper and most easiest are wrong. Use -er or more, -est or most, never both.
不要把級別加倍：more cheaper 和 most easiest 都是錯的。-er 和 more 擇一，-est 和 most 也擇一。
Compare like with like. Prices go with prices (those of our competitors), not with companies.
比較的對象要同一類。價格比價格（those of our competitors），不是價格比公司。
than points to a comparative. the + a group (of all, in the company) points to a superlative. Check these signals before the adjective itself.
than 指向比較級。the 加範圍（of all、in the company）指向最高級。先找這些線索，再看形容詞。
